_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
O wina Mwana nkanda {player_id} na nkanda ya {num_players} ya LiarsDice.
Mvutu:
- Na ntangu yako, o lenda kufua:
  1) Fua bid mpya na wingi mwingi au uso mwinene (kwa mbili zote) kuluta bid ya sasa; yaani '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Yambula bid ya mwisho kwa kutipa '[Call]'.

O yambula:
  - O mwana nkanda alua wingi wa uso huo kati ya nkuku zote ni chini ya bid, mfuasi wa mwisho ahulua nkuku moja.
  - Mbala zingine, yambuli ahulua nkuku moja.
Mwana nkanda alua nkuku 0 ahulua. Mwana nkanda wa mwisho usala.

board.new_round:
Mwaka mpya - Mafuta yaliyobaki: {dice_summary}
Mafuta yako ya sasa ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mwana nkanda {current_player_id} yambula! Wingi wa uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambao ni chini ya {quantity}.
Mwana nkanda {loser_id} (mfuasi wa mwisho) ahulua nkuku moja.
call.caller_loses:
Mwana nkanda {current_player_id} yambula! Wingi wa uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambao ni >= {quantity}.
Mwana nkanda {loser_id} (yambuli) ahulua nkuku moja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Bo bingaka yandi kukonda kulomba ntete mbongo.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Bo pesaka ve mbongo ya bo lombaka: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kazi si yamwene kama fua ya '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]' ya mvutu. Kazi iliyotolewa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Ntalu ya mpa {new_quantity} kele fioti kuluta ntalu yina bo ke sadilaka ntangu yai {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Ntalu ya mpa {new_face_value} kele fioti kuluta ntalu yai {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Bo ta pesa mbongo kiteso mosi ti yina bo ke lomba ntangu yai.
bid_reason.face_range: Ntalu ya bo ke tangaka fwete vanda na kati ya 1 mpi 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} bo katulaka yandi na nsaka sambu yo vandaka ve mbote.

outcome.win: Mwana nkanda {winner} usala! Mfululizo wa mwisho: {final_ranking}
